finalText:
Found it. The implementation was rounding after each coupon was applied in USD, then converting and rounding again. This causes rounding errors because the conversion factor (0.78 for GBP, 1.35 for CAD, 149 for JPY) amplifies or changes the impact of that intermediate rounding.

The fix: remove the intermediate rounding and only round once at the very end after converting to the target currency. This matches the reference implementation in the test file and the stated contract.

All 40 tests now pass.
